title: Guilt Spiral
warm:
Guilt spiral began after [player_name] tipped Rhea that Brooks would raid guest logs—and Rhea's face had done something careful that now looked like foreshadowing of ash. Crownspire night pressed her apartment glass. Detective Imani Brooks sensed obstruction the way sharks sensed blood: not mystical, procedural, escalating toward homicide framing without a settled corpse. Vivienne's calendar still contested. Soft alibi tasted like regret wearing wine.

Nolan Greer sat on her couch across the hall from his own door and did not offer comfort shaped like traveling. Cufflinks quiet for once. "You tipped the eyes. Eyes panic. Panic burns paper. Brooks smells you in the smoke even if your hands never held the match."

[player_name]—early thirties, neighbor-mistress, soft cover bruising—nodded. "I thought I was protecting cadence. Weekly to monthly to gone. I may have protected a fire instead. Four fates still open and I still managed to make the building smaller."

Marcus Pell's name vibrated in unspoken options. Holding-company shadows. Finance-holding badge numbers half-heard on nights Vivienne was marked present. [player_name] could chase an internal badge number that put shadow on Nolan's board—or shield Nolan from Brooks's politics and let guilt become loyalty's ugly twin.

"Shield me and you become soft politics," Nolan said. "Chase the holding badge and you become the woman who puts my board under a light I cannot buy back. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend the tip you already regret."

Elevator chime in the public shaft. Perfume memory across the hall. Black car. Badge flash. Wine ring on her table nesting older hours. She chose between hunting internal shadow and becoming the soft shield.

She catalogued what Crownspire still offered as soft machinery: elevator chime late at night, wine glass ring on marble, Vivienne's unused perfume in a bath she should not know, black car idling at the curb, Brooks's badge flash in the lobby, Nolan's cufflinks clicking when he lied, Rhea's slate with thinning marks, wind sheer against floor-to-ceiling glass. Anchors rotated through the hour without stacking into elegant absolutes. Dialogue had already carried the subtext; the anchors only kept score. Hope and dread shared every doorway. Vivienne's willing leave, paid vanish, death, or staging remained L10-open on purpose—Layer 5 only allowed homicide interest to rise, never a settled corpse to end the wanting or the dread. [player_name] felt the soft alibi's remaining give and understood consequence would spend it either way.

Guilt spiral had a lobby echo and an apartment echo. In the apartment, wine. Across the hall, perfume. Downstairs, Brooks rewriting tip into obstruction narrative as the file cooled toward homicide language. [player_name] had wanted to protect Rhea's slate and may have authored its panic instead. Soft alibis failed sideways. Holding-badge chase offered externalization—shadow on Nolan's board as if shadow could launder her regret. Shielding Nolan offered fusion—guilt becoming loyalty until she could not tell which bruise was whose. Vivienne remained un-settled on purpose; that was the only clean refusal left.
hot:
Guilt made [player_name] want Nolan Greer's hands as absolution and hated the wanting. Soft alibi regret. Early thirties. Across-the-hall couch. Brooks sensing obstruction like a hand at her throat that was also somehow a hand between her legs—procedural dread eroticized only because her body refused clean categories. Vivienne contested. No corpse. Mid-want loud.

"Chase the holding badge," she whispered against his jaw, "or shield you from politics while I stay wet with remorse." His cufflink finally clicked; the tell shivered through her. Shield meant soft loyalty with his mouth as reward and cage. Badge-chase meant putting his board under light while her cunt kept asking for forgiveness shaped like fingers. She chose half-ruined and unfinished.

Body-POV kept the through-line physical: pulse at throat, heat low in the belly, silk clinging, mid-want ending before climax because the next verb still owned the night. Nolan Greer only—mid-forties, finance and tech holding, brutal charm, rain-money cologne—romance lock unbroken. Crime stayed plot; intimacy stayed intimacy-forward, never gore-porn, never eroticizing absence as kink. Brooks's colder paper could press her skin; Vivienne's contested fate could press her ribs; neither turned sex into violence cosplay. [player_name] ached around unanswered questions the way Crownspire ached around a wife who might still be anywhere. Choosing hurt. Hurting meant the choice was real. Soft alibi had a pulse; Layer 5 made her feel every beat.

She climbed into Nolan's lap without finishing the climb—straddle aborted into forehead-to-forehead remorse—and the nearness made guilt feel like foreplay she should not be allowed. Shield-as-reward meant his mouth eventually. Badge-chase meant delayed gratification weaponized as investigation. Soft smut under remorse stayed consenting and bitter. Mid-want did not require moral purity to stay loud.

choices.text: Chase the holding-badge number — shadow Nolan's board
